## Mouser v3.7.20 - Windows QtWidgets DLL search fix

This release fixes a remaining Windows startup failure that could still show:

```text
DLL load failed while importing QtWidgets
```

### Fixed

- Keeps the handles returned by `os.add_dll_directory()` alive for the lifetime
  of the app, so Windows continues to search the bundled PySide6 and shiboken6
  folders while importing Qt.

### Note

- Extract the whole `Mouser` folder before running `Mouser.exe`; do not run the
  exe directly from inside the zip or move it away from `_internal`.
